text:
Maya Li: morning async standup — quick status: what I did / blockers / today
Maya Li: Did: triaged eu-west embed latency spike overnight, checked the runbook, correlated with increased cold starts on the dedicated pool. saw a spike in pending pods + kube events around 03:10 UTC.
Maya Li: Blocker: autoscaler (HPA) didn't bring up capacity fast enough; logs show thrash + frequent scale-downs. need someone to validate k8s metrics (cpu, pod pending, node pressure) and confirm if the recent kube minor upgrade could be related.
Maya Li: Today: I'm going to run a controlled ramp in staging, increase HPA minReplicas to 3 for the dedicated pool, and enable a short prefix-cache warmup. tagging @Lee Chen and @Alex Park for checks.
Lee Chen: On it — checking HPA history and node autoscaler. dashboard: https://dash.company/eu-west/hpa (quick link)
Lee Chen: Early findings: burst in pod evictions + nodes reporting diskPressure for ~5m starting 03:08. there's also a spike of init containers waiting on image pull. looks like a twin issue: image-pull slowness + aggressive HPA cooldown.
Alex Park: I'll update the runbook with a HPA thrash section and a mitigation checklist. Suggest adding `maxSurge` bump on deploys and a preflight job to warm images.
Alex Park: quick note for the runbook PR: include this one-liner for a temporary HPA patch: `kubectl patch hpa embed-dedicated --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'`
Sam Ortiz: I can own the staging ramp test. planning to run the traffic ramp at 10:30 PT and watch for 95p latency and pod pending. can someone be on-call for potential pages?
ops-bot: Pager assigned: Sam Ortiz is now on-call for eu-west ramp test (automated).
Nina Gomez: Suggestion: tweak the embed-latency alert to use 5m 80th percentile instead of 1m p99 to reduce noise from short cold starts. we should also add an alert dedupe for repeated HPA events within 10m.
Lee Chen: Agree with Nina. also adding an item to check image registry latency — I'll run `curl` probes during the ramp.
Maya Li: Thanks — if Lee can confirm image-pull latency and Alex files the runbook PR I'll kick the staging ramp. Sam please mark the test as a maintenance window in the alerting config so paging is muted for the first 5m unless errors spike.
Alex Park: Will open PR within the hour and link it here. PR will include runbook text + a small kubectl snippet for quick patch.
Sam Ortiz: I'll post the ramp schedule and a link to the load script once ready.
Maya Li: Closing out for now — will post results and the runbook PR link after staging test. :thumbsup:
